page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.6xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 24 dedicated virtual cores. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include integrated hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Storage and networking resources reflect an enterprise design reliant on networked components. The instance includes 0 GB of integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for all persistent filesystem needs. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 8 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default. Hardware-level acceleration flags such as AVX-512 extensions and cryptographic offloads are not exposed in the CPU reporting for this instance.

The high density of 192.0 GB of RAM alongside 24 dedicated cores provides cost-efficient operational balance for workloads requiring substantial in-memory footprints without paying for excess compute. The trade-off involves complete reliance on remote block storage due to the absence of local disks. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.6xlarge is targeted at in-memory caching platforms, enterprise relational databases, distributed analytics engines, and medium-scale transactional applications.
